author: New China TV
description: Farmers in the southern Lebanese town of Srifa have resumed harvesting and threshing wheat after months of conflict-related delays, hoping to salvage what remains of this season's crop.
title: Lebanese farmers resume wheat harvest after conflict-related delays

author: New China TV
description:
Watch these robot dogs take on the obstacle course. 
At the ongoing 2026 World AI Conference (WAIC) in Shanghai, young innovators went head-to-head in the WAIC Young finals. Using full autonomous navigation, their quadruped bots identified barriers and mapped paths in real-time. #WAIC2026 #RobotDog #robot #robotics #AI #EmbodiedAI
title: Robot dogs obstacle challenge held at World AI Conference in Shanghai, China

author: New China TV
description: The 2026 World AI Conference (WAIC) is full of futuristic technology -- from robot assistants to industrial AI and healthcare innovations. But if you could take just one of them home, what would you choose? We asked visitors from around the world to find out.
title: Spark Life | Which AI would you take home from 2026 WAIC?

author: New China TV
description: #China's economy has shown resilience with steady growth despite global headwinds, providing an important anchor for #ASEAN's trade, investment and supply chain stability, said Indonesian economist Aden Budi.
title: China's steady growth an anchor for ASEAN: Indonesian economist

author: New China TV
description: #China's economy expanded 4.7% in the first half of 2026 despite global headwinds. Kang Hogu, Director of the Sino-Korea Economy/Society Institute, attributes the resilience to #innovation-driven growth and emerging sectors -- from new energy to #AI and smart vehicles -- that are reshaping the country's economic landscape.
title: Innovation drives China's economic resilience: South Korean expert

author: New China TV
description: A wooden school in Gaza has opened, letting about 850 students return to a classroom for the first time since the conflict in Gaza erupted in October 2023. #GLOBALink
title: First wooden school in war-torn Gaza brings children back to learning

author: New China TV
description:
Can a robot cook your pizza or rally with you in table tennis?
Visitors at the 2026 World AI Conference (WAIC) in Shanghai are experiencing the latest AI-powered robots firsthand, from culinary assistants to sports companions. More than 3,000 AI products and technologies are on display, offering a glimpse into the future of work and everyday life.
#WAIC #AI #Robotics #Innovation #Shanghai #China
title: Foreign visitors react to China's embodied AI development in the 2026 WAIC

author: New China TV
description:
Can robots cook, deliver, guide, or even work alongside humans?
At WAIC 2026 in Shanghai, Xinhua's Sun Qing explores how embodied AI is pushing robots beyond performances and into real-world applications — from factories and hotels to communities and homes. (recorded) #AI #Robots #WAIC2026 #FutureTech #ChinaInnovation
title: Can robots really work? Exploring embodied AI at WAIC 2026

author: New China TV
description:
Imagine a ship that can "vacuum" the seabed 120 meters below the ocean surface. Meet "Jun Guang," one of China's newest homegrown giant dredgers and Asia's largest of its kind.
Equipped with an intelligent control system, it can automate dredging work and make massive marine engineering faster and smarter. #MarineEngineering #Dredging #Shipbuilding #Technology
title: China's homegrown mega dredger enters operation

author: New China TV
description: As rescue efforts continued after a landslide in Pengshui, southwest China's Chongqing, local residents gathered along the streets on Saturday night to welcome and thank the rescue teams arriving to help. #LandslideRescue #RescueTeam #Chongqing #China #CommunitySupport
title: "Thank you for being here": Residents in China's Chongqing greet rescue teams amid landslide

author: New China TV
description: A laser robot is helping cotton farmers in Xinjiang, China. It uses high-energy laser beams to remove cotton buds, a process that helps control plant growth and improve cotton production. The technology reduces chemical use and makes farming more efficient. #China #Robot
title: Laser robot trims cotton in Xinjiang

author: New China TV
description: U.S. forces on Saturday launched a new round of strikes against Iran at 6 p.m. Eastern Time, the U.S. Central Command said in a statement. #XinhuaNews
title: Xinhua News | U.S. forces launch new wave of strikes against Iran

author: New China TV
description:
#WorldCup fever is sweeping the globe. Scarves, jerseys, plush toys, and other merchandise continue to fly off the shelves, bringing the World Cup spirit to fans everywhere.
Behind much of this excitement is a small Chinese city that emerged as an early World Cup winner: #Yiwu, the source of 70% of the tournament's merchandise.
How did Yiwu in east China's Zhejiang Province pull it off? Watch the video and step inside the city powering the World Cup atmosphere.
title: #AmazingChina | World Cup Merchandise Orders Are Surging -- Why Yiwu?

author: New China TV
description: Powerful explosions were heard in the Ukrainian capital of Kiev early Sunday as Russia launched missile attacks against the country, the Ukrainian air force said. #XinhuaNews
title: Xinhua News | Powerful blasts heard in Ukrainian capital

author: New China TV
description: Every rescue is a second chance for wildlife. Join us as we step inside a wildlife rescue and protection center near Hulun Lake in Inner Mongolia, north China, and discover how migratory birds and other wild animals are rescued, cared for, rehabilitated, and prepared for their return to the wild. (recorded)
title: Inside a wildlife rescue and protection center by Hulun Lake

author: New China TV
description:
"Chinese is a very ancient language with profound depth. I believe learning this language will create many opportunities," said a Chinese learner in Kazakhstan. 
At Al-Farabi Kazakh National University, the Confucius Institute is helping young people in the country explore the Chinese language and culture. #BeltandRoad
title: Kazakh students inspired to learn Chinese, eye future opportunities

author: New China TV
description: Dreamy shades of pink and crimson illuminate the sky over Xishuangbanna, Yunnan, as the city's lights gradually come to life beneath the tropical twilight.
title: Sunset glow paints the skyline in SW China's Xishuangbanna
